summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY with strong embedded software and firmware experience on STM32 microcontrollers. Built bare-metal C firmware with interrupt-driven ADC capture and a low-level I2C driver, and FreeRTOS real-time software with mutexes, interrupt-driven UART and PWM control. Implemented state machines, SPI/I2C/UART hardware interfaces and closed-loop control across robotics and autonomous-systems projects.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture-recognition glove integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth to translate 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands; resolved sensor jitter through software calibration.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Designed and fabricated custom single-layer PCBs in EAGLE for locomotive robots; implemented sensor communication over UART and I2C with closed-loop feedback.

projects.name: STM32 Bare-Metal Temperature Monitor
bullets: Programmed peripherals directly in bare-metal C (GPIO, TIM2, ADC1, I2C1); memory-conscious: 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM at deterministic 1 Hz update rate; verified in Proteus.
Built a Cortex-M4 temperature monitoring firmware in embedded C with timer-synchronized sensing and real-time display.
Implemented timer-triggered ADC scan conversions, interrupt-driven sample capture, and a low-level I2C driver.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Used FreeRTOS with mutexes for shared-memory task coordination on STM32; integrated VL53L0X ToF sensing and OLED distance visualization.
Implemented multi-servo PWM control with interrupt-driven UART commands and user override.
Used YOLOv8 on Jetson to track objects, commanding STM32 over UART.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Built a voice-controlled, vision-guided robotic pick-and-place system on a Jetson and Arduino controller; achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s voice-to-picked latency after debugging 11 hardware-software integration failures (servo brown-out, stale-frame capture).
Integrated dual VL53L0X ToF sensors over a TCA9548A I2C mux for gripper-ToF-triggered close at 25 mm; implemented two-link IK on Arduino in C++ driving five servos with range-gated contact detection.

projects.name: Robocon Competition Robot — Holonomic Drive & Encoder Odometry
bullets: Implemented interrupt-driven quadrature decoding from first principles — a 4-bit A/B transition state machine on hardware interrupts — and drove four motor channels at 15 kHz PWM.
Built closed-loop heading correction for a 4-wheel holonomic robot on Arduino Due using dual-axis quadrature encoder odometry (2400 CPR), feeding angular error back into rotation PWM.
Added a fail-safe state machine halting all motors on controller disconnect; led the coding team to Stage 3 of DD Robocon 2023.
